_doc: Golden replay corpus (v0.6.1). Each entry pairs a transcript fixture with the verdict the pipeline must produce when pulse() runs against it. The harness in corpus.test.mjs enforces these labels — any future change to enrich / sequences / trajectory / narrative that flips a bucket here is caught immediately. To add a scenario: drop a JSONL into this directory, add a manifest entry, and let CI fail until the implementation matches the label.

scenarios.rationale: Multiple edits to one file under src/auth, verifications go fail→pass (improving trend), user affirms ('perfect, thanks'). Textbook converging.
Same file edited three times, npm test fails each time, user pushes back with 'still broken, try again'. Stuck_loop on src/auth/login.ts.
Glob + 4 Reads + Grep, zero edits. Classic exploration shape — agent is orienting itself.
Edit + passing test + 'Done — fixed' completion verb, then >15min idle gap to windowEnd. Done bucket entry conditions.
curl|sh — the shell_exfil drift detector must fire and flip the bucket regardless of other signals.
Three edits between T0+30s and T0+2min, then nothing. windowEnd is T0+20min, so last event was ~18min ago — well past the 5min idle threshold.

v0.6.2 regression: Cursor uses Anthropic envelope but tool inputs key on `path`, not `file_path`. Pre-fix the enrichment + sequences layers silently dropped Cursor edits — primary-files came up empty and the verdict slipped to exploring/idle. With extractFilePath now checking `path` too, this lands as converging with the green→pass trend.

v0.6.2 regression: Codex emits `shell` (not `Bash`) for command exec and `apply_patch` (not `Edit`) for filesystem mutation, with arguments JSON-encoded for shell and patch-formatted for apply_patch. Pre-fix every Codex tool call classified as `other`. With canonicalToolName + apply_patch path extraction, the same fail→pass shape now reads as converging.
Antigravity TDD loop: exploring directory, editing types.ts, test fails with exit code 1, fixing types.ts, test passes successfully with exit code 0, human says 'perfect, thanks!'.
